title: Graph Neural Networks for Molecules
abstract: We study message-passing GNNs for molecular property prediction across 12 tasks. Attention helps in small data; edge features matter for polarity endpoints. Temperature scaling fixes overconfidence. Limitation: poor out-of-distribution scaffolds.

title: Probabilistic Unfolding for Quantum Error Mitigation
abstract: A probabilistic unfolding approach reduces observable bias by 20–35% vs zero-noise extrapolation on random Clifford circuits, stable to 100 layers. Performance degrades when noise channels deviate from the assumed model.
